name: @red-cup-engineering/games-catalog-storefront
description: Pure catalog.json -> TUFTE-tile shaping for 561 Group games storefronts: escaping, honest play-link gating against a caller-supplied live-routed-subdomain set, catalog filtering/search/shelf state, and the shared glyph set. Carries no HTTP, no DOM, no site branding -- each site parameterizes it with its own catalog entries and its own live-subdomain set.
